attributes.title: 2027 AAOHN National Conference
attributes.organizer: American Association of Occupational Health Nurses
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Occupational Health Nurses runs its 2027 National Conference as an all-virtual event on three days: June 10, June 12 and June 15, 2027. Because there is no venue, occupational and employee health nurses can join from their own workplace or home.

AAOHN says continuing nursing education will be offered and that the total number of contact hours will be announced once the program is final. Fees and the session list were not published when we checked. AAOHN also lists a separate in-person Conference of Leaders in Chicago on April 5 and 6, 2027.
